---
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureLlmsTxtExists: true
      ensureLlmsMdExists: true
      ensureLlmsTxtRegexMatches:
        - ['^# llms-txt Book', '^## Pages', '\[.*\]\(.*\.llms\.md\)']
        - []
---

# Preface {.unnumbered}

`llms-txt` set under the `book` key must generate the llms.txt index, the same
way it does under `website`.
